MAKE THE SWITCH WITH CONFIDENCE

Bring your hardest booking to the trial.

01

BookX deserves a place on the shortlist if five, ten or twenty locations and team members map neatly to your operation. Confirm how the plan counts shared resources and inactive staff.

02

A seasonal rental business should test BookX's date-range conditions and seasonal pricing using real high-season and low-season examples. Cowlendar is another option for combining rentals with services, but equivalent pricing rules should be demonstrated.

03

For calendar conflict prevention, simulate an outside calendar event before purchase. BookX explicitly places two-way Google Calendar sync on Business, so compare that tier when external events must block availability.

Your questions, answered.

Does Cowlendar have a free plan?

Yes. Cowlendar has a free plan with all features. Usage allowances apply; the pricing page shows the limits and revenue-based paid tiers.

Is Cowlendar cheaper than BookX?

It depends on the features and booking revenue. Use the calculator above: it compares the lowest documented plan for your selected features and shows the assumptions, rather than comparing unrelated starting prices.

Does Cowlendar support subscriptions, an API and webhooks?

Yes. Recurring service subscriptions and bundles are supported. The public API and webhooks are documented as beta, including subscription-credit bookings and eight webhook events. Review the linked API limitations before planning an integration.

When should I choose BookX instead?

Businesses comparing location counts, team capacity and seasonal pricing. The listing separates basic Google Calendar integration from two-way sync on Business. Do not assume the cheaper plan includes the same synchronization behavior.
